spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m5p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Runways == {"r1", "r2"}
Aircraft == {"a1", "a2"}
Controllers == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
NONE == "none"
Quorum == 2

VARIABLES occupant, holds, votes, cand, phase, openrw

vars == <<occupant, holds, votes, cand, phase, openrw>>

Init ==
    /\ occupant = [r \in Runways |-> NONE]
    /\ holds = [a \in Aircraft |-> NONE]
    /\ votes = [c \in Controllers |-> NONE]
    /\ cand = [rw |-> NONE, ac |-> NONE]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ openrw = {"r1"}

OpenVote(r, a) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ r \in openrw
    /\ occupant[r] = NONE
    /\ holds[a] = NONE
    /\ cand' = [rw |-> r, ac |-> a]
    /\ votes' = [c \in Controllers |-> NONE]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, holds, openrw>>

Vote(c, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[c] = NONE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![c] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, holds, cand, phase, openrw>>

Grant ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ Cardinality({c \in Controllers : votes[c] = "yes"}) >= Quorum
    /\ cand.rw \in openrw
    /\ occupant[cand.rw] = NONE
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![cand.rw] = cand.ac]
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![cand.ac] = cand.rw]
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ cand' = [rw |-> NONE, ac |-> NONE]
    /\ votes' = [c \in Controllers |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED openrw

Deny ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ Cardinality({c \in Controllers : votes[c] = "no"}) >= Quorum
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ cand' = [rw |-> NONE, ac |-> NONE]
    /\ votes' = [c \in Controllers |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, holds, openrw>>

Release(a) ==
    /\ holds[a] # NONE
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![holds[a]] = NONE]
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![a] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, cand, phase, openrw>>

OpenRunway(r) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ r \notin openrw
    /\ openrw' = openrw \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, holds, votes, cand, phase>>

CloseRunway(r) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ r \in openrw
    /\ occupant[r] = NONE
    /\ openrw' = openrw \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, holds, votes, cand, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Runways, a \in Aircraft : OpenVote(r, a)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(c, v)
    \/ Grant
    \/ Deny
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft : Release(a)
    \/ \E r \in Runways : OpenRunway(r)
    \/ \E r \in Runways : CloseRunway(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ occupant \in [Runways -> Aircraft \cup {NONE}]
    /\ holds \in [Aircraft -> Runways \cup {NONE}]
    /\ votes \in [Controllers -> {"yes", "no", NONE}]
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting"}
    /\ openrw \subseteq Runways

Coherent ==
    \A a \in Aircraft :
        holds[a] # NONE =>
            /\ holds[a] \in openrw
            /\ occupant[holds[a]] = a

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Coherent
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator grants each open runway to at most one aircraft
at a time -- a runway is a mutually exclusive critical resource. Because the
decision is safety-critical, granting a runway requires quorum voting: a
coordinator opens a vote pairing a free, open runway with a waiting aircraft,
each of three controllers casts a yes or no vote, and the grant is applied only
if at least two controllers vote yes (a majority-no denies the request and
returns to idle). Once granted, the aircraft holds that runway until it releases
it. The airport's usable capacity changes at runtime: runways can be opened for
service or closed, but a runway may only be closed while it is unoccupied.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every aircraft that holds a runway holds one that is currently open and whose occupant record names that same aircraft, so a runway is never jointly held or held while closed.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od9m9p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Parts == {"n1", "n2"}
Segs == {"g1", "g2"}
ADMIN == "admin"
NONE == "none"
MaxEpoch == 3

VARIABLES epoch, known, members, shedBy, shedEp

vars == <<epoch, known, members, shedBy, shedEp>>

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ known = [p \in Parts |-> 0]
    /\ members = Parts
    /\ shedBy = [s \in Segs |-> NONE]
    /\ shedEp = [s \in Segs |-> 0]

Reconfig ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ members' \in SUBSET Parts
    /\ UNCHANGED <<known, shedBy, shedEp>>

Sync(p) ==
    /\ known[p] < epoch
    /\ known' = [known EXCEPT ![p] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, members, shedBy, shedEp>>

ShedByPart(p, s) ==
    /\ p \in members
    /\ known[p] = epoch
    /\ shedBy[s] = NONE
    /\ shedBy' = [shedBy EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ shedEp' = [shedEp EXCEPT ![s] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, known, members>>

ShedByAdmin(s) ==
    /\ shedBy[s] = NONE
    /\ shedBy' = [shedBy EXCEPT ![s] = ADMIN]
    /\ shedEp' = [shedEp EXCEPT ![s] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, known, members>>

Restore(s) ==
    /\ shedBy[s] # NONE
    /\ shedBy' = [shedBy EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ shedEp' = [shedEp EXCEPT ![s] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, known, members>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfig
    \/ \E p \in Parts : Sync(p)
    \/ \E p \in Parts, s \in Segs : ShedByPart(p, s)
    \/ \E s \in Segs : ShedByAdmin(s)
    \/ \E s \in Segs : Restore(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ known \in [Parts -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ members \subseteq Parts
    /\ shedBy \in [Segs -> Parts \cup {ADMIN, NONE}]
    /\ shedEp \in [Segs -> 0..MaxEpoch]

NoStaleAction ==
    /\ \A p \in Parts : known[p] <= epoch
    /\ \A s \in Segs : shedBy[s] # NONE => shedEp[s] <= epoch

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleAction
nl:
A power-grid load shedder decides which grid segments to disconnect during an
overload. The controller runs epoch-numbered reconfiguration: each time the
member set of trusted node controllers changes, the coordinator increments the
current epoch. A node may shed a segment only if it is a current member and its
locally known epoch equals the coordinator's current epoch; a node whose known
epoch has fallen behind must first resync before it can act, so stale nodes
cannot shed. Every shed is stamped with the epoch under which it happened. A
privileged admin override lets a human operator shed any segment directly at the
current epoch without membership or epoch checks. Segments can also be restored.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No node's known epoch ever exceeds the coordinator's current epoch, and no segment is ever recorded as shed under an epoch greater than the current one.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m3p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Runways == {"r1", "r2"}
Aircraft == {"a1", "a2"}
Controllers == {"c1", "c2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxTerm == 3

VARIABLES leader, term, occupant, holds, msgs

vars == <<leader, term, occupant, holds, msgs>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ term = 0
    /\ occupant = [r \in Runways |-> NONE]
    /\ holds = [a \in Aircraft |-> NONE]
    /\ msgs = {}

Elect(c) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = c
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, holds, msgs>>

CrashLeader ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, occupant, holds, msgs>>

SendReq(a, r) ==
    /\ holds[a] = NONE
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {[ac |-> a, rw |-> r]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, occupant, holds>>

Grant(m) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ occupant[m.rw] = NONE
    /\ holds[m.ac] = NONE
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![m.rw] = m.ac]
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![m.ac] = m.rw]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>

Drop(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, occupant, holds>>

Release(a) ==
    /\ holds[a] # NONE
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![holds[a]] = NONE]
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![a] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, msgs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Elect(c)
    \/ CrashLeader
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft, r \in Runways : SendReq(a, r)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : Grant(m)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : Drop(m)
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft : Release(a)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Controllers \cup {NONE}
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ occupant \in [Runways -> Aircraft \cup {NONE}]
    /\ holds \in [Aircraft -> Runways \cup {NONE}]
    /\ msgs \subseteq [ac : Aircraft, rw : Runways]

MutEx ==
    /\ \A a \in Aircraft : holds[a] # NONE => occupant[holds[a]] = a
    /\ \A r \in Runways : occupant[r] # NONE => holds[occupant[r]] = r

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutEx
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator uses leader election with failover among its
controllers: at any time at most one controller is the elected leader (each
election bumps a term), and only the current leader may grant runways. If the
leader crashes, it steps down and a new one is elected. Aircraft send grant
requests naming a desired runway; these requests travel over a network that may
reorder them, so they accumulate in an unordered pool and the leader may service
any pending request in any order. The leader grants a request only if the target
runway is free and the aircraft holds no runway. Requests may also be dropped,
and an aircraft may release its runway.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The occupant record and the per-aircraft holdings always agree both ways, so no runway is ever occupied by two aircraft and no aircraft holds a runway not recorded as its own.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m6p5t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Zones == {"z1", "z2"}
Drones == {"d1", "d2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxClock == 3
LeaseDur == 2

VARIABLES lease, leaseExp, clock, dropped, droppedBy, active

vars == <<lease, leaseExp, clock, dropped, droppedBy, active>>

Init ==
    /\ lease = [z \in Zones |-> NONE]
    /\ leaseExp = [z \in Zones |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ dropped = {}
    /\ droppedBy = [z \in Zones |-> NONE]
    /\ active = Zones

Acquire(d, z) ==
    /\ z \in active
    /\ lease[z] = NONE
    /\ clock + LeaseDur <= MaxClock
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![z] = d]
    /\ leaseExp' = [leaseExp EXCEPT ![z] = clock + LeaseDur]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, dropped, droppedBy, active>>

Expire(z) ==
    /\ lease[z] # NONE
    /\ clock >= leaseExp[z]
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![z] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseExp, clock, dropped, droppedBy, active>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, leaseExp, dropped, droppedBy, active>>

Drop(d, z) ==
    /\ z \in active
    /\ lease[z] = d
    /\ clock < leaseExp[z]
    /\ z \notin dropped
    /\ dropped' = dropped \cup {z}
    /\ droppedBy' = [droppedBy EXCEPT ![z] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, leaseExp, clock, active>>

AddZone(z) ==
    /\ z \notin active
    /\ active' = active \cup {z}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, leaseExp, clock, dropped, droppedBy>>

RemoveZone(z) ==
    /\ z \in active
    /\ lease[z] = NONE
    /\ active' = active \ {z}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, leaseExp, clock, dropped, droppedBy>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones, z \in Zones : Acquire(d, z)
    \/ \E z \in Zones : Expire(z)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E d \in Drones, z \in Zones : Drop(d, z)
    \/ \E z \in Zones : AddZone(z)
    \/ \E z \in Zones : RemoveZone(z)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ lease \in [Zones -> Drones \cup {NONE}]
    /\ leaseExp \in [Zones -> 0..MaxClock]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ dropped \subseteq Zones
    /\ droppedBy \in [Zones -> Drones \cup {NONE}]
    /\ active \subseteq Zones

DropCoherent ==
    \A z \in Zones :
        /\ (z \in dropped) <=> (droppedBy[z] # NONE)
        /\ (z \in dropped) => (droppedBy[z] \in Drones)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DropCoherent
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm assigns survey zones to drones using
lease-based ownership with expiry: a drone acquires a lease on an active zone
that carries an expiry time, and the lease is dropped once the clock passes its
expiry. A global clock ticks forward. The irreversible action is releasing
fire-retardant over a zone: a drone may do this only while it holds a still-valid
(unexpired) lease on that zone, and only once per zone -- a zone already treated
can never be treated again. The swarm's coverage capacity changes at runtime:
zones can be added to or removed from the active set, but a zone may only be
removed while it holds no lease.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A zone is recorded as retardant-dropped if and only if it has a recorded dropping drone, and every dropped zone's dropper is a real drone.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m4p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets

Cranes == {"k1", "k2"}
Jobs == {"j1", "j2"}
NONE == "none"
Cap == 3
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES curEpoch, craneEpoch, queue, inflight, log

vars == <<curEpoch, craneEpoch, queue, inflight, log>>

Init ==
    /\ curEpoch = 0
    /\ craneEpoch = [c \in Cranes |-> 0]
    /\ queue = << >>
    /\ inflight = [c \in Cranes |-> NONE]
    /\ log = {}

Recredential ==
    /\ curEpoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ curEpoch' = curEpoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<craneEpoch, queue, inflight, log>>

Sync(c) ==
    /\ craneEpoch[c] < curEpoch
    /\ craneEpoch' = [craneEpoch EXCEPT ![c] = curEpoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curEpoch, queue, inflight, log>>

Enqueue(j) ==
    /\ Len(queue) < Cap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, j)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curEpoch, craneEpoch, inflight, log>>

Claim(c) ==
    /\ craneEpoch[c] = curEpoch
    /\ inflight[c] = NONE
    /\ queue # << >>
    /\ inflight' = [inflight EXCEPT ![c] = Head(queue)]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curEpoch, craneEpoch, log>>

Complete(c) ==
    /\ inflight[c] # NONE
    /\ log' = log \cup {[job |-> inflight[c], by |-> c, ep |-> craneEpoch[c]]}
    /\ inflight' = [inflight EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curEpoch, craneEpoch, queue>>

Next ==
    \/ Recredential
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Sync(c)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Enqueue(j)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Claim(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Complete(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ curEpoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ craneEpoch \in [Cranes -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ Len(queue) <= Cap
    /\ inflight \in [Cranes -> Jobs \cup {NONE}]
    /\ log \subseteq [job : Jobs, by : Cranes, ep : 0..MaxEpoch]

NoStaleWorker ==
    /\ \A c \in Cranes : craneEpoch[c] <= curEpoch
    /\ \A rec \in log : rec.ep <= curEpoch /\ rec.by \in Cranes

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleWorker
nl:
A container-ship crane yard dispatches lift jobs through a bounded work queue
with backpressure: jobs are appended to a shared queue only while it is below its
capacity, so a full queue exerts backpressure and rejects further enqueues.
Cranes are periodically re-credentialed -- a global recredential bumps the
current epoch, and each crane must sync its local epoch to become authorized
again. A crane may claim the job at the head of the queue only while it is
authorized (its local epoch equals the current epoch) and it is not already
carrying a job. A crane can be slow but not failed: once it claims a job it holds
it in flight and completes it later (possibly after a delay), never dropping it;
completion appends a processing record stamped with the epoch it acted under.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No crane's local epoch ever exceeds the current epoch, and every processing record was written by a real crane under an epoch no greater than the current one.

---- MODULE W4Od11m2p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Printers == {"p1", "p2"}
Jobs == {"j1", "j2"}
Instances == {"i1", "i2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES owner, votes, phase, prop, coord

vars == <<owner, votes, phase, prop, coord>>

Init ==
    /\ owner = [p \in Printers |-> NONE]
    /\ votes = [i \in Instances |-> NONE]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ prop = [printer |-> NONE, job |-> NONE]
    /\ coord = NONE

Propose(i, p, j) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ owner[p] = NONE
    /\ coord' = i
    /\ prop' = [printer |-> p, job |-> j]
    /\ votes' = [x \in Instances |-> NONE]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

Vote(i, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[i] = NONE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![i] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, phase, prop, coord>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A i \in Instances : votes[i] = "yes"
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![prop.printer] = prop.job]
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, prop, coord>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E i \in Instances : votes[i] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, votes, prop, coord>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ prop' = [printer |-> NONE, job |-> NONE]
    /\ votes' = [i \in Instances |-> NONE]
    /\ coord' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

Release(p) ==
    /\ owner[p] # NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![p] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, phase, prop, coord>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, p \in Printers, j \in Jobs : Propose(i, p, j)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(i, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Reset
    \/ \E p \in Printers : Release(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Printers -> Jobs \cup {NONE}]
    /\ votes \in [Instances -> {"yes", "no", NONE}]
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting", "committed", "aborted"}
    /\ coord \in Instances \cup {NONE}

NoDoubleGrab ==
    (phase = "voting") => (owner[prop.printer] = NONE)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleGrab
nl:
A print shop runs two independent spooler instances that share one pool of
printers. To hand a printer to a job exclusively, an instance runs two-phase
commit across both instances: the coordinating instance proposes assigning a
free printer to a job, both instances vote yes or no, and only a unanimous yes
commits the assignment; any no aborts the round. A printer is proposed only when
it currently has no owner, which is what keeps the two instances from both
grabbing the same printer. After a commit or abort the round resets to idle, and
a committed printer can later be released back to the pool.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a voting round is in progress, the printer it is trying to assign has no current owner, so a printer is never allocated to two jobs at once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m3p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Chutes == {"c1", "c2"}
Controllers == {"x1", "x2"}
NONE == "none"
Cap == 2
MaxPending == 3

VARIABLES leader, load, crashed, pending

vars == <<leader, load, crashed, pending>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ load = [c \in Chutes |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ pending = 0

Elect(c) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ leader' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, crashed, pending>>

CrashLeader ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {leader}
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, pending>>

Recover(c) ==
    /\ c \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, load, pending>>

ArriveBag ==
    /\ pending < MaxPending
    /\ pending' = pending + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, load, crashed>>

Route(ch) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ pending > 0
    /\ load[ch] < Cap
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![ch] = load[ch] + 1]
    /\ pending' = pending - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, crashed>>

Deliver(ch) ==
    /\ load[ch] > 0
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![ch] = load[ch] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, crashed, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Elect(c)
    \/ CrashLeader
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Recover(c)
    \/ ArriveBag
    \/ \E ch \in Chutes : Route(ch)
    \/ \E ch \in Chutes : Deliver(ch)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Controllers \cup {NONE}
    /\ load \in [Chutes -> 0..Cap]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Controllers
    /\ pending \in 0..MaxPending

CapOK ==
    \A ch \in Chutes : load[ch] <= Cap

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapOK
nl:
An airport baggage router sorts bags into chutes, each of which holds a bounded
number of bags. Routing decisions are made by a single elected leader controller
using leader election with failover: at most one controller is leader at a time,
and only the leader may route bags. A controller can crash silently -- the leader
may simply fail, after which it steps down and is marked crashed; a crashed
controller may later recover and rejoin so it can be elected again. Bags arrive
into a pending backlog. The leader routes a pending bag into a chute only when
that chute is below its capacity; bags are later delivered off the chute.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No chute ever holds more bags than its capacity.

Units == {"b1", "b2"}
Recipients == {"r1", "r2"}
Stations == {"s1", "s2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxEpoch == 2

    /\ owner = [u \in Units |-> NONE]
    /\ holds = [r \in Recipients |-> NONE]
    /\ reqs = {}
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ members = Stations

Reconfig ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ members' \in SUBSET Stations
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, holds, reqs>>

    /\ holds[r] = NONE
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {[rec |-> r, unit |-> u]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, holds, epoch, members>>

Commit(m) ==
    /\ m \in reqs
    /\ members # {}
    /\ owner[m.unit] = NONE
    /\ holds[m.rec] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![m.unit] = m.rec]
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![m.rec] = m.unit]
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, members>>

Cancel(m) ==
    /\ m \in reqs
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, holds, epoch, members>>

    /\ holds[r] # NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![holds[r]] = NONE]
    /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reqs, epoch, members>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfig
    \/ \E r \in Recipients, u \in Units : Request(r, u)
    \/ \E m \in reqs : Commit(m)
    \/ \E m \in reqs : Cancel(m)
    \/ \E r \in Recipients : Release(r)

    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, recorded, acked>>

Submit(u) ==
    /\ u \notin pending
    /\ u \notin recorded
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, recorded, acked>>

Record(u) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ u \in pending
    /\ recorded' = recorded \cup {u}
    /\ pending' = pending \ {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, acked>>

Ack(u) ==
    /\ u \in recorded
    /\ u \notin acked
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, pending, recorded>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Elect(c)
    \/ CrashLeader
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Submit(u)
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Record(u)
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Ack(u)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Controllers \cup {NONE}
    /\ pending \subseteq Updates
    /\ recorded \subseteq Updates
    /\ acked \subseteq Updates

NoLostUpdate ==
    acked \subseteq recorded

nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker keeps a shared inventory record that many stations
update concurrently, and it must never lose an update. Update operations are
submitted as messages over an unordered channel, so they accumulate in a pending
set and may be recorded in any order (reordering). The tracker uses leader
election with failover: at most one controller is the elected leader, and only
the current leader records a pending update into the shared record; if the leader
crashes it steps down and a new one is elected, and pending updates simply wait to
be recorded by the next leader. An update is acknowledged to its station only
after it has actually been recorded into the shared inventory, so an acknowledged
update can never have been dropped.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every acknowledged update has been recorded into the shared inventory, so no acknowledged update is ever lost.
